subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback remain fail-closed when microphone state is unknown, blocking audio until Meet explicitly reports micMuted: false?
rationale: This changes the effective readiness policy for existing browser-managed sessions; tests establish the intended code path, but they cannot determine whether the compatibility tradeoff is acceptable for real Meet DOM behavior.

options.title: Confirm fail-closed policy with runtime proof
options.body: Keep the explicit-unmuted requirement, require redacted signed-in local and paired-node recovery evidence, and merge once the observed browser behavior matches the new contract.

options.title: Preserve permissive unknown-state behavior
options.body: Retain the prior readiness behavior for unknown microphone state and limit the PR to transcript and tab-recovery fixes until a separately approved strict policy is available.

recommendation.title: Confirm fail-closed policy with runtime proof
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit-unmuted requirement, require redacted signed-in local and paired-node recovery evidence, and merge once the observed browser behavior matches the new contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the shared meeting-bot and Google Meet adapter paths, including the deferred policy decision now implemented here.
